name: World ID headless QR session example
description: Next.js headless-session reference presenting a QR code and connection/confirmation/error states from useSession, with proof display and clipboard export.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
metadata.overlap: World ID client integration, not the biometric recognition system or a standalone authentication server. Session confirmation/client UI success does not establish application authorization; verify proofs and bind actions/signals on a trusted backend.
metadata.deployment_warning: Demo logs the connector URI and shows/copies proof results; remove that exposure and add trusted backend verification before production.
